items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: When I became a member of AFO... Smokey, and, uh, Emil Vinette, give them two weeks notice... and bring in John Boudreau.

ctx.x: Well, it wasn't so much that. When I became a member of AFO, they said, look, man, since we're going to be working in the studio, we need to work together as often as possible. Mm-hmm. So, why don't you, we, we talk about paying the band at, at, at, uh, the guys in the band, Smokey, and, uh, Emil Vinette, give them two weeks notice, and pay them for two weeks, and bring in John Boudreau.
